title: Even experienced cooks will learn something
text: I was impressed by the professionalism of this experience.  The chef really knew his stuff and even though I am an experienced cook I learnt several tips and techniques.  The market is excellent and the food delicious.
author: Discover61316854355

title: Fun, fabulous, authentic cooking class in Seville!
text: Our class with Anna and Carlo was fabulous!!  I was there with my adult daughter and we both enjoyed it a great deal.  Their instructions were clear and easy to follow, the atmosphere was fun, informative and welcoming.  The group was just the right size.  And the food - AMAZING!!  An absolutely wonderful delicious three course meal, abundant portions, authentic cuisine.  It was definitely a highlight - a must-do if in Seville!
author: P461SXandreal

title: You should do this- great fun!!! .. and learning too
text:
This was the highlight of our European trip! I learned many delicious recipes and how to de-bone a chicken! 
I booked this as a surprise for my partner- when I told him, he didn’t seem too excited. When we were there, he looked so happy and told me many times how great it was!!! If I was ever to come to area again, I’d do this class just for the fun! Thank you Diana and Clara!
author: 582alannaa

title: The class was very well...
text: The class was very well done and organized. The staff, Dom and Anna, were great.  The recipes are really good and will be easy to make at home.

title: A fun experience in Seville
text: Thank you to Clara and Tony for an enjoyable experience. The market tour was informative and the cooking class was a lot of fun. The food was great and we enjoyed learning how to make tapas and paella. We would absolutely recommend this to others.

title: Excellent experience
text: Excellent experience.  The food tour was informative.  The cooking class was well organized and the food was very good.  Highly recommend it.
